notes: Builds a campaign template locally and prints JSON — it does **not** execute anything. Fill in the values, then pipe it to [`ktm ci run`](/cli/commands/ci/run) with `--stdin`.
ci_build.metaDescription: Generate a local-only campaign JSON template with ktm ci build using test IDs or a saved Tests campaign, then pipe it into ci run.

notes: Executes a campaign produced by [`ktm ci build`](/cli/commands/ci/build) (from a file or `--stdin`). Use `--junit-file` / `--output-file` for CI reporting; the exit code is non-zero when any test fails.
ci_run.metaDescription: Run and poll Kapptivate tests from JSON configs or campaign JSON via the ktm ci run command, then report JUnit or JSON results.

notes: Fast, minimal detail (required variables and owner slots), ideal before building a campaign. For the full definition with actions and dependencies, use [`ktm tests inspect`](/cli/commands/tests/inspect).
Full test definition (actions, dependencies, configuration). If you only need the variables and owners to build a campaign, [`ktm tests get`](/cli/commands/tests/get) is faster.
Hides a test without deleting it; reversible with [`ktm tests unarchive`](/cli/commands/tests/unarchive). To move a test to trash instead, use [`ktm tests delete`](/cli/commands/tests/delete).
Soft-deletes to trash, recoverable with [`ktm tests undelete`](/cli/commands/tests/undelete). To merely hide a test from listings, use [`ktm tests archive`](/cli/commands/tests/archive).
Restores tests from trash — the counterpart to [`ktm tests delete`](/cli/commands/tests/delete).
Un-hides an archived test — the counterpart to [`ktm tests archive`](/cli/commands/tests/archive).

Sets ONE variant's value on a grouped variable, preserving the other variants. To change a variable's name, description, or default value, use [`ktm variables update`](/cli/commands/variables/update).
Updates a variable's properties (name, description, default value). To set a single variant's value, use [`ktm variables set-value`](/cli/commands/variables/set-value).
Creates a saved, named, reusable pack of tests. For a one-off run from explicit test IDs, skip this and use [`ktm ci build`](/cli/commands/ci/build) with `--test-ids` instead.
Creates a scheduled, recurring execution of a test. For a single ad-hoc run, use [`ktm ci build`](/cli/commands/ci/build) then [`ktm ci run`](/cli/commands/ci/run) instead.
Raw InfluxQL against monitor KPIs. For SLO compliance use [`ktm metrics slo`](/cli/commands/metrics/slo); for cross-signal correlation use [`ktm metrics correlate`](/cli/commands/metrics/correlate).
Alert definitions are the persistent rules that trigger incidents. The incidents they raise are managed under [`ktm incidents`](/cli/commands/incidents).
alerts.metaDescription: Manage ktm alerts from the CLI to view and list persistent alert definitions that automatically trigger incidents on the platform.

notes: Incidents are triggered alert occurrences (OPEN / CLOSED). The rules that create them live under [`ktm alerts`](/cli/commands/alerts).
incidents.metaDescription: Manage KTM incidents from the CLI to list, view, close, and count triggered alerts across OPEN, CLOSED, and MANUALLY_CLOSED states.

adb.metaDescription: Connect Android Studio or the ADB CLI to remote phones via a secure tunnel, then enable, monitor, and disable device access per agent.

adb_connect.metaDescription: Run `ktm adb connect` to open a local ADB tunnel to a remote phone, exposing it to Android Studio and your local ADB server.

adb_disable.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm adb disable command to turn off an agent's ADB bridge and terminate all active device connections.

adb_enable.metaDescription: Enable the ADB bridge on an agent with ktm adb enable so its phones accept ktm adb connect, without restarting the agent.

adb_status.metaDescription: Check each Android phone's agent, ADB bridge status, and current connection holder using the ktm adb status command.

agents.metaDescription: Manage ktm agents with the CLI to monitor infrastructure health, control capacity, list slots, and toggle runtime adapter features.

agents_adapters.metaDescription: List, enable, disable and configure an agent's runtime-controllable adapters, including ADB bridge settings, using the ktm agents adapters command.

agents_get.metaDescription: Use the ktm agents get command to view detailed health, capacity, and slot information for a single agent by hostname or UUID.

agents_list.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm agents list command to list agents for an operator, with filtering options by type and zone.

agents_maintenance.metaDescription: Use the ktm agents maintenance command to enable or disable maintenance mode and pause or resume test execution on an agent.

agents_reboot.metaDescription: Use the ktm agents reboot command to restart a cellular, ethernet, or smartphone agent or a specific SIM slot.

alerts_get.metaDescription: Retrieve a specific alert definition's configuration and notification settings by ID using the ktm alerts get CLI command.

alerts_list.metaDescription: Use the ktm alerts list command to view configured alert definitions for an operator, filtering by type, name, or archived status.

artifacts.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm artifacts command to fetch screenshots, recordings, and other test artifacts from the CLI.

artifacts_get.metaDescription: Use ktm artifacts get to download screenshots, logs, or traces by URL or relative path directly from the command line.

ci.metaDescription: Run CI/CD tests with ktm ci by executing JSON config files, polling for results, and reporting outcomes automatically.

collections.metaDescription: Manage the ktm collections command to organize tests and dashboards into a hierarchical tree using create, move, rename, and search subcommands.

collections_can-edit.metaDescription: Check edit permissions for a collection using the ktm collections can-edit command, which returns a simple can_edit boolean via the CLI.

collections_create.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm collections create command to add a new sub-collection under a specified parent collection UID.

collections_delete.metaDescription: Learn how to use ktm collections delete to soft-delete a collection into the organization's trash, requiring the --yes confirmation flag.

collections_get.metaDescription: Use the ktm collections get command to fetch a collection's metadata and breadcrumb path by UID for a specified operator.

collections_items.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm collections items command to list paginated tests and dashboards inside a specified collection.

collections_list.metaDescription: Use the ktm collections list command to view direct child collections of a specified parent UID within an operator scope.

collections_move-items.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm collections move-items command to atomically relocate tests or dashboards into a target collection via the CLI.

collections_move.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm collections move command to reparent a collection under a new parent UID via the CLI.

collections_search.metaDescription: Search collections and items within a collection sub-tree using the ktm CLI, with support for filtering by query, tags, and owner ID.

dashboards.metaDescription: Manage ktm dashboards from the CLI, including creating, listing, updating, and configuring widgets for operator-level analytics.

dashboards_add-widget.metaDescription: Add a widget to a dashboard from a JSON file or stdin, using auto-positioning or explicit grid coordinates and size.

dashboards_build.metaDescription: Use ktm dashboards build to atomically create dashboards with all widgets validated upfront and auto-positioned, previewing layouts via dry-run.

dashboards_create.metaDescription: Use the ktm dashboards create command to quickly generate a new empty dashboard under an operator with a required name.

dashboards_edit-widget.metaDescription: Use ktm dashboards edit-widget to replace a widget's data from a JSON file or stdin while keeping its type unchanged.

dashboards_get.metaDescription: Retrieve a dashboard's full definition by UID using the ktm CLI, including widget layouts, filters, and metadata.

dashboards_list-widget-types.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm dashboards list-widget-types command to view available widget types, their constraints, and grid sizes.

dashboards_remove-widget.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm dashboards remove-widget command to delete a specific widget from a dashboard by its ID via the CLI.

dashboards_update.metaDescription: Update dashboard metadata like name, bucket, and favorite status using the ktm dashboards update command with simple flags.

dashboards_validate-widget.metaDescription: Validate a dashboard widget JSON file with the ktm CLI, checking structure, query fields, and type-specific constraints before deployment.

dashboards_widget-template.metaDescription: Generate a JSON template for ktm dashboards widget-template widgets like line, counter, and customDisplay charts easily.

executions.metaDescription: Explore the ktm executions command to view campaign run results, including detailed per-test pass/fail data for your product.

executions_get.metaDescription: Retrieve detailed results for a specific test execution by ID, including status, pass/fail counts, and full JSON output via the ktm CLI.

executions_list.metaDescription: List, filter, and search test executions for a product using the ktm CLI, with options for status, date range, and creator.

incidents_close.metaDescription: Learn how to use the ktm incidents close command to manually close an active incident by ID for a specified operator via the CLI.

incidents_counter.metaDescription: Use the ktm incidents counter command to quickly retrieve critical, warning, and closed incident counts for any operator.

incidents_get.metaDescription: Use the ktm incidents get command to retrieve a single incident's tags, status, level, duration, and alert source by ID.

incidents_list.metaDescription: Use the ktm incidents list command to filter, paginate, and review triggered alert incidents by status, alert ID, or date range.

init.metaDescription: Scaffold a ready-to-use Kapptivate test-authoring workspace with skills, MCP config, and catalog layout using the ktm init command.

login.metaDescription: Authenticate with the ktm CLI using OAuth 2.1 + PKCE to securely log in to Kapptivate and store your access token.

logout.metaDescription: Use the ktm logout command to clear stored OAuth tokens from your keychain and revoke them server-side when possible.

metrics.metaDescription: Use the ktm metrics command to query monitor KPIs, passive collector data, and device utilization stored in InfluxDB.

metrics_alert-eval.metaDescription: Run ktm metrics alert-eval to check InfluxDB metrics against threshold, anomaly, and seven other alert rule types without Kapacitor.

metrics_correlate.metaDescription: Run ktm metrics correlate to detect correlation, distribution shift, and lag across InfluxQL queries with configurable analysis modes.

metrics_peak-usage.metaDescription: Retrieve P95 peak resource usage across custom time aggregation windows using the ktm metrics peak-usage CLI command with flags.

monitoring-results.metaDescription: Use the ktm monitoring-results command to view and list run outcomes from your scheduled monitors directly via the CLI.

monitors.metaDescription: Manage ktm monitors via CLI to create, edit, list, toggle, and force-run scheduled test executions with status tracking.

operators.metaDescription: Manage ktm operators with the CLI to list top-level entities that own products, tests, and users in your organization.

products.metaDescription: Manage ktm products with the CLI, including listing applications or services under an operator that contain tests and monitors.

resources.metaDescription: Explore the ktm resources command to list and get details on SIMs, web agents, and smartphones for test execution.

reusables.metaDescription: Manage reusable test fragments with the ktm CLI, including getting definitions, listing usage, and viewing embedded tests.

shell.metaDescription: Run interactive live shell commands on SIM cards and web agents, sending USSD, SMS, calls, or HTTP requests in real time.

status.metaDescription: Run "ktm status" to verify CLI connectivity, authentication state, host configuration, version, and API latency before running commands.

test-campaigns.metaDescription: Manage ktm test-campaigns from the CLI to create, list, update, delete, and fetch saved test packs before running them.

tests.metaDescription: Manage automated test scenarios with the ktm CLI: create, edit, validate, archive, restore, and inspect tests from your terminal.

update.metaDescription: Learn how to use ktm update to check for, download, and install the latest ktm CLI release, or pin a specific version.

use.metaDescription: Use ktm use to view or switch the workspace's default product stored in .ktm.json, streamlining commands that rely on --product.

users.metaDescription: Manage human users and service accounts with the ktm users command, including activation, deactivation, and listing options.

variables.metaDescription: Manage ktm variables, groups, and variants with dedicated subcommands for creating, listing, updating, and deleting configuration values.

variables_groups.metaDescription: Variable groups: environment configurations holding a set of variants

variables_variants.metaDescription: Variants: environment slices inside a variable group (dev, staging, prod, …)

whoami.metaDescription: Check which identity the ktm CLI authenticates as using ktm whoami, revealing API key or stored OAuth token details.

overview.description: Explore the ktm CLI's 149 commands across 28 groups, covering global flags, resources, monitors, incidents, and more.
